meta.via: county and agency websites and the North Carolina OEMS licensed-agency list (local sources)

services.name: Guilford County EMS
services.evidence: Guilford County EMS is the sole provider of paramedic-level pre-hospital services in Guilford County. County paramedic transport units are easily recognizable by their distinctive yellow and white paint scheme.

37081.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: Forsyth County Emergency Services (EMS)
services.evidence: They respond on average to 100 emergency calls per day throughout the county. Eighteen ambulances operate within the county and city of Winston-Salem during the course of daily operations.

37067.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: Durham County EMS
services.evidence: Durham County Emergency Medical Services (EMS) was established in 1975 to provide professional prehospital care and emergency medical services to the residents of Durham County. ... Durham County EMS provides 24/7 emergency medical services to the community, operating up to 19 ambulances during the day and 10 at night

37063.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: Union Emergency Medical Services
services.evidence: As the primary 911 EMS system for Union County's population of about 300,000 citizens, Union EMS receives over 25,000 requests on average for service per year. ... Union Emergency Medical Services is a CAAS accredited EMS agency that is managed by Atrium Health

37179.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: New Hanover Regional EMS (Novant Health)
services.evidence: If you experience a medical emergency within New Hanover County, our emergency medical services (EMS) will be sent to provide pre-hospital care in the field and, if needed, transport you to the most appropriate emergency department. ... Our ambulances are stationed at a number of locations throughout New Hanover County.

37129.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: Cleveland County EMS
services.evidence: Cleveland County Emergency Medical Services (EMS) provides paramedic-level emergency medical and patient transport services throughout Cleveland County. Our mission is to provide rapid, high-quality emergency medical care to those in need, anytime and anywhere across our 469 square miles of primarily rural communities.

37045.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: Rutherford County EMS
services.evidence: The agency serves the entirety of Rutherford County, encompassing 564 square miles ... making it the primary EMS provider for both residents and visitors of the county.

37161.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026); no city ambulance operator is licensed there.

services.name: FirstHealth Lee EMS (FirstHealth of the Carolinas)
services.ownership: hospital (private contractor to Lee County, franchise)
services.evidence: Lee County provides 911 Emergency Medical Services (EMS) and certain medically necessitated non-emergency transport within the County through a contracted franchise service provider.

37105.page_note: The county commissioners awarded the ambulance franchise to FirstHealth of the Carolinas in June 2026, effective when the previous contract ended June 30, on a new five-year, $2.87 million contract. MedEx was picked in late 2025 but talks failed.

services.name: Vance County Fire and EMS (county department)
services.evidence: Our department responds to approximately 6,000 EMS calls and 1,000 Fire related incidents within Vance County and the City of Henderson on a annual basis. ... The department operates 5 fire apparatus and 3 EMS units continuously on a twenty-four hour basis out of two stations.

37181.page_note: The only agency with transport capability based in the county on the North Carolina OEMS list (September 2026). The county's 2025 State of the County report lists EMS as paramedic-level care and transport, with 7,835 calls in 2024, 73% within the city.

services.name: Hertford County EMS
services.evidence: Hertford County EMS will provide emergency medical care and transport to all citizens within the boundaries of Hertford County. Our service provides advanced life support care twenty four hours per day, seven days per week.

37091.page_note: Six other services are franchised for non-emergency transport only under the Hertford franchise ordinance; the county does not list them as 911.

services.name: Cape Fear Valley Health Cumberland County EMS
services.evidence: Cape Fear Valley Health's Cumberland County Emergency Medical Services (EMS) is a vital service that provides emergency medical care and transportation to the residents of Cumberland County.

services.name: Womack Army Medical Center Ambulance Service (Fort Bragg EMS)
services.evidence: NC OEMS Continuum record only; womack.tricare.mil page returned 403; 2011 army.mil article (via search) says on-post 911 response. Not opened.

37051.page_note: Cape Fear Valley Health EMS covers the county, per its own page and the county emergency communications center. Not yet confirmed from a public source: the role of the Womack Army Medical Center ambulance service on Fort Bragg.

services.name: Harris Regional Hospital EMS
services.area: all of county from Thorpe Power Plant north, excluding Cherokee Reservation
services.evidence: Harris EMS has provided 911 service for Jackson County since January 1st, 1996. ... covers all areas of the county from the Thorpe Power Plant, north, with the exception of the area within the Cherokee Reservation.

services.name: Glenville Cashiers Rescue Squad Inc
services.evidence: NC OEMS Continuum agency record only (no opened page)

services.name: Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians tribal EMS (Qualla Boundary)
services.evidence: Job posting (found by search, not opened) refers to the 'Cherokee Tribal EMS Program'; not confirmed as 911 transport in Jackson.

37099.page_note: Harris Regional Hospital EMS (source from 2021), Glenville Cashiers Rescue Squad and the Eastern Band of Cherokee tribal EMS serve parts of Jackson County. Not yet confirmed from a current public source: the southern part (Glenville-Cashiers) and the Qualla Boundary.

services.name: Jones County EMS
services.evidence: We operate two 24-hour EMS units. The Jones County EMS Director serves as a coordinator between the County, volunteer, and private EMS services in Jones County.

services.name: Phillips Crossroads, Comfort, Trenton, Wyse Fork, Maysville, Pollocksville Volunteer EMS departments
services.evidence: There are six volunteer EMS Departments in Jones County: Phillips Crossroads Volunteer EMS Comfort Volunteer EMS Trenton Volunteer EMS Wyse Fork Volunteer EMS Maysville Volunteer EMS Pollocksville Volunteer EMS

37103.page_note: The county page names six volunteer EMS departments (Phillips Crossroads, Comfort, Trenton, Wyse Fork, Maysville, Pollocksville) but does not say whether they transport or which area each covers.

services.name: Robeson County EMS
services.evidence: Robeson County EMS is the primary provider of Emergency Medical Care to the citizens of Robeson County and visitors within our county. ... In 2025 Robeson County EMS answered 24,456 calls for service, with assistance from our other system providers, a total of 41,196 calls were answered.

37155.page_note: The county page lists system plan members (Lumberton Rescue & EMS, South Robeson Rescue, Rowland Rescue, Maxton Rescue, Pembroke Rescue & EMS, Red Springs Rescue, St. Pauls EMS, Red Springs Fire, Parkton Fire, Lumberton City Fire) but does not say which transport or where.

services.name: Iredell County EMS
services.area: whole county incl. Statesville, Mooresville, Troutman, Harmony, Love Valley
services.evidence: Iredell County EMS (ICEMS) is the sole Advanced Life Support (ALS) EMS provider for the 598-square-mile county.

37097.page_note: Confirmed: Iredell County EMS. Iredell County Rescue, North Iredell Rescue Squad and Troutman Rescue Squad also hold state transport licences; their role is not yet confirmed from a county page.

services.name: Gaston County EMS (GEMS)
services.evidence: GEMS deployment consists of 9 Paramedic ambulances ... assigned to EMS stations located throughout Gaston County. ... Gaston County's EMS System is supplemented by 1 Volunteer Rescue Squad that provide Rescue and Ambulance services.

37071.page_note: Confirmed: Gaston County EMS. Not yet confirmed from a county page: the volunteer squad (the state list shows Dallas Township Rescue Squad), and a 2024 news item says the county took over a town's ambulance service after a 48-year contract ended.

services.name: Brunswick County EMS
services.evidence: We provide emergency medical responses to the residents and visitors of Brunswick County.

37019.page_note: Confirmed: Brunswick County EMS. The county directory lists Bald Head Island Public Safety, Southport Rescue Squad and St. James Fire and EMS, which hold state transport licences; not yet confirmed whether or where they transport.

services.name: Pitt County EMS
services.evidence: The EMS system is a coordinated network that includes private nonprofit paramedic agencies, municipal and local government advanced life support teams, private non-emergency transport services, and a hospital-based specialty care transport program. System Partners Include: City of Greenville Fire-Rescue ...

37147.page_note: Confirmed: Pitt County EMS. Greenville Fire/Rescue and six nonprofit rescue squads are also licensed; not yet confirmed from an agency page what areas they cover.

37057.page_note: Davidson County Rescue Squad is licensed to transport, but the county page does not mention it. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who provides county 911 ambulance service.

37135.page_note: South Orange Rescue Squad is licensed to transport, but the county page does not mention it. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who provides county 911 ambulance service.

37159.page_note: Four rescue squads or fire departments are licensed to transport, and the county page only links a rescue squad page. Not yet confirmed from a public source: who answers 911.

37101.page_note: The county page says it oversees contracted EMS agencies without naming them.

37021.page_note: Eight agencies are licensed to transport (the county, a rescue squad and five fire departments). Not yet confirmed: who answers 911 where, because the county page could not be read.

37035.page_note: Six rescue squads and fire departments are licensed to transport; the county page says only that it works closely with local rescue squads.

37085.page_note: Harnett County EMS backs up all contract EMS agencies, which the county lists by district (Anderson Creek, Benhaven, Boone Trail, Dunn, Erwin and others). Not yet confirmed: how these match the eight transport licences.

services.name: Burke County EMS
services.evidence: Burke County EMS is the sole provider of 911 medical services in the 514 square miles of Burke County. ... In addition to emergency 911 response, Burke County EMS offers non-emergency medical transport

37023.page_note: Burke County EMS answers every 911 medical call in the county and transports patients. Fire and rescue departments are first responders only. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.

services.name: Stanly County EMS
services.evidence: Stanly County Emergency Medical Services (EMS) is the primary 911 emergency medical provider for Stanly County, North Carolina ... Coverage is provided across the entire county with strategically placed bases and units
services.vintage: undated, current (16,000 calls a year, Atrium medical direction)

37167.page_note: Stanly County EMS is the 911 ambulance service for the whole county; its published data includes patient transports by destination. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.
37167.second_source: https://www.stanlycountync.gov/505/Operational-Data (lists 'Transports By Destination-summary') ; https://www.ems1.com/ems-products/patient-handling/stanly-county-ems-enhances-operations-through-adoption-of-hinckley-medicals-onedose-system (2025-09: "Stanly County EMS staffs six full-time advanced life support ambulances")

services.name: Scotland County EMS
services.evidence: Scotland County Emergency Medical Service is a countywide paramedic level EMS organization ... The system operates 3 ambulances and 1 supervisor QRV on 24 hour shifts. Patients are transported to Scotland Memorial Hospital and Moore Regional Hospital.

37165.page_note: Scotland County EMS runs the ambulances for the whole county. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.

services.name: Northampton County Ambulance Service
services.evidence: The mission of the Ambulance Service is to provide primary Advance Life Support emergency care to the citizens of Northampton County on a first-out basis 24 hours per day, seven days per week.

37131.page_note: The county-run Northampton County Ambulance Service answers 911 calls across the county; it opened a fourth station in Conway for the eastern end. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.

services.name: Chowan County EMS
services.evidence: Chowan County EMS (CCEMS), a county owned and operated service, started in 1965 and currently serves as the primary emergency and non-emergency medical service provider for all 233 square miles of Chowan County to include the town of Edenton. ... Chowan County EMS operates a fleet of 6 type III advanced life support ambulances

37041.page_note: Chowan County EMS runs the ambulances for the whole county, Edenton included. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.

services.name: Camden County EMS
services.evidence: Camden County EMS is a county-operated emergency medical service established February 15th, 2025 to bring dedicated coverage to the residents and visitors of Camden County. ... 24/7 Ambulance Coverage One ambulance based in Shiloh One ambulance based in South Mills

37029.page_note: Since February 2025 Camden County runs its own ambulance service, with ambulances in Shiloh and South Mills and a surge unit at the courthouse. Neighbouring services may still help on busy days. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.

services.name: Pamlico County Rescue Squad (Pamlico Rescue)
services.evidence: Emergency Medical Services are provided by Pamlico Rescue who maintain staffing around the clock at the Main Station in Bayboro ... Transportation of Medical Emergencies are made to Carolina East Hospital in New Bern, NC.
services.vintage: page predates 2023 (names Vidant); no sign of change: still the only licensed transporter in Sept 2026

37137.page_note: Pamlico Rescue, a nonprofit rescue squad, runs the 911 ambulances for the county from Bayboro, with a daytime unit near Oriental. Fire departments are first responders only. No other ambulance service is licensed in the county.

37191.page_note: Wayne County EMS answers 911 calls across the county and is the only ambulance service licensed there. A county page saying it transports patients has not been found yet, and whether Seymour Johnson Air Force Base runs its own ambulance is not confirmed.

37093.page_note: Cape Fear Valley runs the county's contracted ambulance service. The part of Fort Bragg inside Hoke County may be served by the Army's own ambulance service at Womack, which is not yet confirmed.

37199.page_note: Yancey County's page describes its own paramedic ambulances, but the state licence list names the county's only transporter as Heritage EMS. How the two names relate is not confirmed.

services.name: Lenoir County EMS
services.evidence: The Lenoir County EMS is a division of Lenoir County Emergency Services that provides treatment and transport for the sick and injured in Lenoir County.

37107.second_source: https://lenoircountync.gov/emergency-services-department/emergency-medical-services/ (same page: six EMS stations located throughout the county); NC OEMS Continuum: Lenoir County EMS is the only agency in the Lenoir system whose primary service is 911 scene response with transport (other Lenoir-system ambulance companies are licensed for convalescent transport)

services.name: McDowell County EMS
services.evidence: McDowell County Emergency Medical Services (EMS) is responsible for providing emergency medical care to all citizens and visitors of McDowell County. EMS covers 437 square miles

37111.page_note: McDowell County EMS is responsible for emergency medical care across all 437 square miles and runs five ambulances daily. The McDowell County Rescue Squad also holds a state ambulance licence with three permitted ambulances, and whether it transports 911 patients has not been confirmed.
37111.second_source: https://wlos.com/news/local/mcdowell-county-ems-ends-pause-transfers-to-mission-hospital-emergency-services-director-will-kehler-mission-health-hca-healthcare-significant-improvements-wait-times-no-delay (Jan 2024: McDowell County EMS ambulances transfer patients to Mission Hospital)

services.name: Edgecombe County Emergency Services (EMS Division)
services.evidence: Our prehospital professionals staff six ambulances 24/7, one "peak-time" ambulance from 7a-8p

37065.second_source: https://www.edgecombecountync.gov/departments/emergency_services/edgecombe_medical_services/station_locations.php (2026: "Covering approximately 506 square miles"; Station 500 primary district "covers Rocky Mount, West Edgecombe, Sharpsburg"); state agency licence for Edgecombe County EMS issued 01/2021, after the county took over the rescue squad; https://www.rockymounttelegram.com/news/local/edgecombe-county-set-to-take-over-rescue-squad/article_5098f02c-0d51-539d-ab54-5468079b1c5a.html (Oct 2020: the rescue squad "is the sole 911 provider in Edgecombe County" and was folded into county Emergency Services by Jan. 2021)

services.name: Currituck County Fire & Emergency Medical Services
services.area: whole county (stations Moyock, Sligo, Waterlily, Grandy, Powells Point, Corolla, Carova, Knotts Island)
services.evidence: Staffs 9 ambulances and 3 fire engines (The 3 staffed engines are Advanced Life Support certified) 24-hours-a-day.

37053.second_source: same page: Provides Advanced Life Support emergency medical treatment/transport, vehicle extrication

services.name: Washington County EMS
services.evidence: Washington County EMS is the sole provider of Paramedic pre-hospital services to the entire population of Washington County.

37187.second_source: https://albemarleobserver.news/2026/04/09/solar-permit-ems-overhaul-headline-washington-county-commission/ (Apr 2026: county moves EMS under Emergency Management, still a county department)

services.name: Washington-Tyrrell EMS (Washington County EMS under contract to Tyrrell County)
services.evidence: emergency medical services, which Tyrrell County contracts with Washington County to provide.

37177.second_source: https://dl.agd.cc/TyrrellWeb/2026budget.pdf (Tyrrell County FY 2026-2027 budget, presented 5/19/2026: "AGREEMENTS - WASH. CO. EMS. 675,000.00"); https://washconc.org/departments/emergency-medical-services/; https://washconc.org/departments/emergency-medical-services/ (Washington County EMS page)

services.name: Caswell County EMS
services.evidence: We deliver prompt pre-hospital care and medical transport, using advanced equipment, proven protocols, and a deep commitment to patient well-beling.

37033.second_source: same page: Whether it's a 911 call or a community event, our mission remains the same.

services.name: Mitchell County EMS
services.evidence: Our core service is rapid pre-hospital care, lifesaving emergency medical services, expert patient stabilization, and transport.

37121.second_source: Mitchell County EMS state agency licence issued 07/30/2025 (county took over from Mitchell Medics); county page ©2018-2026 describes the county-run service; same page: provide quality, efficient, and professional emergency services to the citizens and visitors of Mitchell County, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

services.name: Perquimans County EMS
services.evidence: We were able to staff the two ambulances for the move, as well as maintain the three crews (in Perquimans County) for normal emergency response,
